about.title: About Me
abstract: I started out as a UX/UI designer, crafting interfaces with HTML and CSS. But once I discovered the magic behind coding dynamic interfaces, I fell in love with development.

What sets me apart is not only my strong foundation in CSS, but also my deep understanding of user interface design, interaction patterns, and development principles—all now enriched by my current Master's studies in Artificial Intelligence.
